newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia cuts internal coffee price sharply.
newsitem.headline: Colombia cuts internal coffee price sharply.

text.p: Colombia cut its internal coffee price by a steep 11.6 percent Friday to 393,375 pesos per 125-kg load.

The price cut, from 445,000 pesos per load set just last Friday, was the fourth since Jan 31 when a new sliding-scale formula was introduced to calculate payments to domestic growers and help the local price track the sharp run-up in world prices.
A spokesman for the National Coffee Growers' Federation said the new price was based on the lowest average trading price for Colombian coffee in New York over the past week of $2.33 per pound.
Until last week, when the internal price was cut by 2.19 percent, the price formula was based on the average trading price per pound rather than the lowest average price.
